Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
Patrick Drapeau wrote:
>
> I have been answered about voting... But the problem is that i have read
> somewhere that non-camarilla vamps cant push Praxis Seizure until they are
> part of the camarilla or their clan is accepted. Is it true?

Non-Camarilla clans cannot become Princes (until they are part of the Camarilla) or
Justicars (ever).

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
13...@quebectel.com (Patrick Drapeau) writes:

>I have been answered about voting... But the problem is that i have read
>somewhere that non-camarilla vamps cant push Praxis Seizure until they are
>part of the camarilla or their clan is accepted. Is it true?

Yes. It is also true that they cannot be named Archons nor Cam Exemplaries
until they shed their non-Camarilla status.

Nor can they call an Archon, Cam Exemplary, or burn the Elysium vote until
they shed their non-Camarilla status.

entitles you to the benefits and abilities thereof.
